title: feat(quests): monthly leaderboard on the enter quests page
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `GET /api/quests/standings`: this month's (UTC) Quest Pollen ranking, trimmed to the top 3 plus 2 above / you / 1 below for the signed-in viewer
- Every quest reward counts, top-ups included; top-up earners get a small Pollen supporter marker
- Adds the "October leaderboard" panel under Claimed on `/quests`: days left, your highlighted row, and the gap to the next row with the cheapest open quest that closes it
- Signed out: top 3 + "Sign in to join"; not ranked yet: "Earn any quest to join"
- Tests: API ranking/neighbourhood/supporter/last-month exclusion, and the rendered next-step line

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| enter `/quests` | no ranking | personal monthly race |
| Public board (pollinations.ai) | all-time bounties | unchanged |

gist.headline: A little friendly competition
gist.blurb: Quests get a monthly leaderboard. Polli can see who's ahead, how much Pollen separates them, and which open Quest might close the gap.
gist.summary: Adds GET /api/quests/standings and a monthly UTC leaderboard on enter's /quests page, showing the top three, nearby ranks, days remaining, and the cheapest open Quest that closes the gap to the next rank.
gist.impact: Signed-in Quest earners get a highlighted rank and a concrete next step; signed-out visitors see the top three, while top-up earners receive a Pollen supporter marker.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden race represented by three flower-pot podiums and a small leaderboard on a retro screen. Polli studies her highlighted place beside a nearby Quest flower that could close the gap; a tiny Pollen badge marks a supporter.
